# Shake DeFi

> Shake DeFi is a non-custodial DeFi platform on TON and Ethereum Base featuring two core products:
> 1. **Tradable NFT-Backed Debt Notes (TON & Base)**: Collateralized crypto loans backed by verified physical-asset or digital-image Ownership NFTs. Lenders and note buyers earn fixed monthly principal and interest payments (yield) in TON, USDT, USDC, or ETH, and can sell or transfer active notes on secondary markets before maturity. Borrowers keep physical possession of pledged items with fixed 1–60 month amortization, zero price oracles, and zero margin calls. Available on the Shake Web App and Telegram Mini App only (not iOS or Android native apps).
> 2. **Smart-Contract Escrow & Ownership NFTs**: Non-custodial payment escrow (0.1%–1% fee) for P2P goods, services, and e-commerce, plus direct Ownership NFT minting and wallet-to-wallet NFT sales (0.1% fee).

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://shakedefi.com/): Overview of Shake DeFi's tradable NFT-backed debt notes on TON & Base, collateralized lending, and non-custodial smart-contract architecture.
- [Shake Markets](https://shakedefi.com/marketplace): Explore NFT Debt Note Markets (Web & Telegram Mini App), including the public unauthenticated Market Snapshot JSON, and the P2P Marketplace with smart-contract escrow.
- [How It Works](https://shakedefi.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to Tradable NFT-Backed Debt Notes (collateral verification, funding, fixed monthly repayments, secondary trading, and default claims) and Smart-Contract Escrow.
- [Physical Asset & Digital NFTs](https://shakedefi.com/nft): How to mint Ownership NFTs for real-world physical assets and digital images on Base (ERC-721) and TON, dual-layer privacy verification, and 0.1% direct sales.
- [Secure Payments](https://shakedefi.com/secure-payments): Non-custodial smart-contract payment escrow for real-world commerce, vehicles, wholesale commodities, and services.
- [Get Paid](https://shakedefi.com/get-paid): Merchant-focused information about accepting crypto payments, fees (0.1%–1%), escrow periods, withdrawals, and payment flexibility.
- [Send Payments](https://shakedefi.com/send-payments): Buyer-focused information about paying through escrow, transaction documentation, reputation, privacy, and dispute protection.
- [FAQ](https://shakedefi.com/faq): Common questions about Shake DeFi's escrow, Ownership NFTs, supported wallets and chains (TON & Base), fees, refunds, disputes, privacy, and country availability.
- [E-Commerce Registration](https://shakedefi.com/e-commerce): Merchants can set up an account to use Shake's API to accept cryptocurrency in their own e-commerce storefront.
